einzeiler: New evidence in the Malibu murder trial and deadly disputes in Virginia and New Mexico.
kurzfassung: Prosecutors in the high-profile Malibu murder trial of Frazier Boehm dropped a new allegation regarding a large nitrous oxide canister found in his car. Meanwhile, an elementary school shooting in Waynesboro, Virginia, left a staff member injured and the gunman dead. Additionally, an argument over a home-cooked meal in Albuquerque ended in the fatal shooting of a man by his cousin.
stichpunkte: Frazier Boehm faces charges for a high-speed crash that killed four Pepperdine sorority students in October 2023.
Prosecutors claim a large nitrous oxide canister was resting on Boehm's lap before the crash, causing severe distraction.
The defense argues the crash was an accident caused by road rage and secured a trial delay until December.
In Waynesboro, Virginia, a 19-year-old gunman breached Westwood Hills Elementary School and shot an adult staff member before killing himself.
The injured staff member was treated and released, and no children were harmed in the elementary school library.
Superintendent Jeffrey Cassell praised lockdown protocols and became emotional during the official briefing.
In Albuquerque, New Mexico, Irvin Joaquin Gutierrez was arrested for fatally shooting his cousin, Nathaniel Cavazos, following an argument over whose enchiladas were spicier.
Gutierrez shot Cavazos multiple times in the back before fleeing and sending Snapchat messages claiming self-defense.

clips.hook: Nitrous oxide tank found in lap during 104 mph crash
clips.text: Court filings reveal that the driver had a large nitrous oxide canister resting on his lap moments before slamming into parked vehicles at excessive speeds.

clips.hook: Defense demands delay over blood smears on nitrous tank
clips.text: The lead defense attorney requested an immediate trial continuance to inspect the vehicle and examine blood smears discovered on the tank nozzle.

clips.hook: Gunman takes his own life in empty school library
clips.text: Police found the armed intruder dead from a self-inflicted gunshot wound inside the library, where fortunately no children were present at the time.

clips.hook: Superintendent breaks down over school safety nightmare
clips.text: The local school superintendent became visibly choked up while addressing reporters and urged parents to hug their children tightly.

clips.hook: Argument over spicy enchiladas erupts into gunfire
clips.text: A heated family debate concerning who made the spicier dish escalated into a physical altercation ending with a fatal shooting.

beschreibung:
Trial proceedings for Fraser Bohm, accused of killing four Pepperdine sorority sisters on Malibu’s Pacific Coast Highway, are delayed following explosive claims that a nitrous oxide canister was found inside his vehicle. No Virginia elementary school children harmed after a nineteen-year-old gunman opens fire near the library, injuring a staff member. A New Mexico man is in police custody after allegedly shooting his cousin in the back during a argument over whose green chile enchiladas were spicier. Sydney Silvagni reports.
